name: Celestial Coral Wyrm Spire
introDiscord: A tower of celestial coral twists upward like a frozen comet trail. Warm light pulses through the reefstone while long Wyrms circle the spire in spiraling paths.
introTwitch: A tower of celestial coral twists upward like a frozen comet trail. Warm light pulses through the reefstone while long Wyrms circle the spire in spiraling paths.

spiral-reefrise.prompt: The reef rises in a glowing spiral around three ascending paths. Warm comet-coral pulses beneath your hands while Wyrms coil around the tower outside.

left.message: A Fae vessel is wedged onto a ledge halfway up the spiral. The view is spectacular. The drop is also spectacular. Inside are Star Candies.

right.message: Shizuki's Wyrmfire cordial reads: "Warm enough to remind your bones they have duties. Glimmer declined. Glimmer has no bones to motivate."
right.fullHpMessage: The Wyrmfire cordial remains sealed. You are already at full health, and your bones require no additional motivation.

forward.message: A Celestial Coral Wyrm coils around the outer tower, passes you once, then reverses direction and comes back with significantly less peaceful intentions.

wyrmcoil-terrace.prompt: A coiled terrace overlooks nearly all of Moonlit Reef. Three arches lead inward while Wyrms weave through the open tower above.

left.message: A Wyrm is sunning itself in warm comet-coral. Your arrival creates shade. Apparently this is an unforgivable offense.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache is fused halfway into glowing coral. Heat has kept it spotless for centuries—and kept everyone else from touching it. You carefully recover Star Candies.

forward.message: Shizuki's note reads: "Do not confuse surviving fire with permission to stop. Also let bottle cool before drinking. New rule."
forward.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's cooled remedy remains untouched. At full health, you can obey at least one new rule and leave the bottle alone.

comet-coral-crown.prompt: The spire's highest chamber glows like a captured star. Three passages curve around the crown while Wyrm shadows circle outside.

left.message: Shizuki's old shelter contains one Berry beside a list titled 'THINGS I'M DOING AFTER I GET OUT.' Most entries involve food, maps, and 'go somewhere nobody knows me.'

right.message: A Wyrm loops around the entire crown and dives through one opening. It emerges from another before you finish turning around.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer glows red-hot beneath comet coral. Waiting approximately thirty seconds feels deeply unfair, but eventually you recover Star Candies without cooking yourself.

boss-antechamber.name: Ascendant Pinnacle
boss-antechamber.prompt: The spiral paths narrow onto the spire's highest pinnacle. Celestial coral burns like a captured star while an immense coil circles beyond the crown.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Wyrms circling the Spire abruptly scatter.

Heat surges through every vein of celestial coral.

Something vast coils around the entire pinnacle.

Use /yes to climb higher or /no to reconsider challenging something that can hug a tower.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Wyrms circling the Spire abruptly scatter.

Heat surges through every vein of celestial coral.

Something vast coils around the entire pinnacle.

Use !yes to climb higher or !no to reconsider challenging something that can hug a tower.
bossRetreatText: You descend from the Ascendant Pinnacle. The vast coil loosens around the tower, but the celestial coral remains hot beneath your hands.

boss.revealText: An enormous Wyrm rises around the pinnacle in a spiral of stellar light. The Celestial Wyrm Ascendant has claimed the crown!

completionText: The Ascendant releases the tower and disappears into the upper current. The coral cools to a gentle glow, revealing another path down toward Moonlit Reef.
